# HyperStrata
> Local LLM inference: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE GGUF (Unsloth UD quants q4-q6) on 8 GB VRAM + 32 GB RAM, Windows + CUDA, with q4_0 KV cache.
> Chain: Strata (Niko1221/Strata) -> PolyStrata (VecSzn/PolyStrata) -> HyperStrata (this fork, no upstream endorsement).

- [README](README.md): What this is, how to run it, and the measured baseline.
- [Index](docs/INDEX.md): Full doc map.
- [Install](docs/HOW-TO-INSTALL.md): How to check the PC, set up, start and verify the server.
- [Models](docs/MODELS.md): Which weight files load and their VRAM/RAM cost.
- [KV cache](docs/KV_CACHE.md): Which `--kv` and `--draft-kv` formats exist and when to use them.
- [Backends](docs/BACKENDS.md): How the engine is put together per model family.
- [Details](docs/DETAILS.md): Every measured number, the API and all settings.
- [Benchmarks](docs/BENCHMARKS.md): Which runs were measured and on what rig.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): What to check when setup or inference fails.
- [Flags reference](--help.md): Flags, checked against `hyper.exe --help`.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Release history.
- [Upstream divergence](UPSTREAM_DIVERGENCE.md): What this fork changes relative to upstream.
- [Third party](THIRD_PARTY.md): Third-party pieces and their licenses.
